verdict.rationale: The README documents a promptless install path: it says you can "install all skills for Claude Code, Codex, and Pi without prompts" (gh-2). It also shows a flag-driven single-skill install, `npx skills add yylo-dev/yylo-skills --skill wiki-yylo` (gh-3), and an explicit `yy skills install` / `yy skills update` command that updates all agent copies (gh-6), all of which an agent could script headlessly. Missing for 10: the exact non-interactive command and flags are not shown in the evidence, there is no hands-on or independent confirmation that an agent can run it end to end, and how unattended runs handle copies that need review (docs-3) is unclear.
